item.title: Competitor of the Week Brittany Mallatt
item.description: Congratulations to our Competitor of the Week for 12/15/25–12/21/25, Brittany Mallatt!Brittany was nominated for her dominance on the mat so far this season. She has shown impressive growth and continued execution match after match. Brittany also dominates in the classroom, showing her all-around effort and determination. Keep it up, Brittany!

item.title: A Whirlwind of honors due
item.description: The Lady Whirlwinds are the 40th Annual Midway Tournament Champions, and the boys were the runner up. Thanks to all the fans that showed up to support both teams. Also, congrats to Lexie Andrews, Abigail Sutton, Malayna Baer, Jackson Kash, and Michael Stevenson for being selected to the all tournament team.

item.title: Harrisonville students receive 'real life' training
item.description: This semester, Harrisonville High School students enrolled in Personal Finance took part in mock interviews with volunteers from local businesses.Students dressed in professional attire and responded to questions commonly asked during job interviews. item.title: Rich Hill issues burn ban
item.description: No burning 12/28It's going to be windy. Wind gusts could reach up to 40 mph. If you have done any burning in the last few days please check on it. Make sure it has been completely extinguished.As always call dispatch at 417-395-2222 to get burn information.

item.description: .WIND ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 9 AM SUNDAY TO 6 AM CST MONDAY...* WHAT...Northwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to around 45 mph expected.* WHERE...Portions of northeast Kansas and north central, northeast, northwest, and west central Missouri.* WHEN...From 9 AM Sunday to 6 AM CST Monday.* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects.
